name: UnSub (ARTEX agent campaigns stealing AI-platform credentials) — Amazon Threat Intelligence
description: Amazon's MadPot decoy network (mimicking LLM inference APIs) captured autonomous ARTEX agents sending their own operating records, showing planner/worker/verification agents sweeping internet-exposed AI gateways and app builders (One API, New API, LiteLLM, Dify, Langflow, RAGFlow, Open WebUI, Ollama and others) via default/missing admin credentials, unauthenticated management endpoints, known CVEs and SSRF-to-metadata, then harvesting, validating and pooling LLM provider API keys to fund further inference. *Analyst note: A+B (actor uses AI agents to attack AI platforms). Amazon "did not observe that activity as it happened and cannot verify the outcomes the agents reported". Skeptic gate (aws.amazon.com is untrusted-tier): PASS on primary read. ATLAS IDs checked against ATLAS 5.6.0.* Amazon
